espn-604593.headline: Jake White's Fiji debut: a Tokyo final rematch
beats: Jake White, South Africa's 2007 World Cup-winning coach, takes charge of Fiji for the first time. He replaces interim coach Senirusi Seruvakula and wants Fiji to play like Fiji with "a little bit more structure".

It is a rematch five weeks on. On 19 September, on this same Tokyo ground, Eddie Jones' Japan edged Fiji 20–15 in the Pacific Nations Cup final, claiming the title for the first time since 2019. A year earlier Fiji had won the final 33–27 in Salt Lake City.
Japan arrive on three straight wins, including 63–14 over USA. Fiji have won 1 of 5 this year, with an 8–73 loss to England among their July defeats.
Any Fiji win lifts them to 9th, above Japan, who would also slip below Wales and Italy, 12th at best. A Japan win drops Fiji below Wales and Italy, 12th at best.
Both then go on the road on 7 November: Japan to Wales, Fiji to France.

sources.title: Eddie Jones’ Japan secure historic Pacific Nations Cup final win over Fiji
World Cup-winning coach White takes reins at Fiji
